description: 367373 chain-qualified token identities in the P3 v6 declared 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-15 UTC scope. Local review candidate; rights unresolved; no public license asserted. Existing article snapshots are read-only.
name: Three-chain launch registry and retrospective expectation context - P4 local candidate
rai:dataBiases: Single declared week and selected launch platforms; bounded market discovery; old metadata cohort selected by historical collection and access success.
rai:dataCollection: Fixed P3 v6 native evidence and public historical market observations; legacy six-table metadata summaries. No new online acquisition during P4 acceptance.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Saved original provider responses and normalized native transaction/log envelopes; unavailable old metadata HTTP bodies remain unavailable.
rai:dataLimitations: Declared platform/version/address scope only; Four.meme V1 excluded. Market scalar construction and historical rule revisions unverified. Legacy metadata coverage is Solana only. Real lifecycle awaits integration.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenance: Local immutable personal candidate; P5 integration and external release require a new version and rights review.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Public wallet addresses can be linkable. Do not infer personal identity or equate token inactivity/metadata failure with people or project failure.
rai:useCases: Data provenance, deterministic ETL reuse, identity/time joins, coverage inspection. Not investment advice, natural-person identification, causal inference or certified prospective prediction.
